parse.title: Horror from the Deep/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|
*To begin the quest use the fairy ring code {{fairycode|ALP}} to teleport to the lighthouse. Alternatively, one could teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or [[Grouping teleport]] then hop over the rocks to the north to reach the lighthouse. 
*Talk to [[Larrissa]]. {{Chat option|1With what?|1But how can I help?|1Okay, I'll help!|3I'll see what I can do}}
*Run east to the second bridge, use a plank on it.
*Jump the bridge and use a second plank on it.
*Head over to Barbarian Outpost, enter the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course|Barbarian Outpost Agility arena]] and talk to [[Gunnjorn]] for a key. In order to enter the arena, you need to have completed the [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl|barcrawl]] miniquest.
**While at the outpost, prepare for the battle against the Dagannoth and Dagannoth Mother.
**''(Optional)'' Complete a lap of the Agility course to complete a medium Kandarin task.
*Talk to Larrissa again.
*Go to the roof of the lighthouse and use the swamp tar, tinderbox, and molten glass on the lighting mechanism.
*Climb down to the basement, use 1 of each elemental rune, any sword, and any arrow on the [[strange wall (Lighthouse)|strange wall]].
*Open the eastern strange wall of the doorway, climb down the ladder and talk to [[Jossik]].
*Kill the level 100 [[Dagannoth (Horror from the Deep)|Dagannoth]] then the level 100 [[Dagannoth Mother]] by using any elemental magic attack from the table below.}}
